x: Nearly 100 members,friends and visitors were present at the Club dinner amongst whom were W.J.Pepper, J.Binks, E.H.Neville, W.F.May, E.H.Collden, W.C.Jewell,and W.J.Palmer.
The Whitsun British Games, organised by Joe Binks at the White City, drew a crowd of 20,000, and one of the highlights of the meeting was a Three Miles match between ourselves and Birchfield H.

By working in conjunction with Joe Binks who helped with advice and by giving medals for various races, a very strong unit Track team was formed in the Midlands, and in between war duties the team won many races, getting invitations in aid of the Red Cross.
The Mayor of Brighton distributed the awards and Joe Binks of The News of the World, organisers of the race, spoke of some of the outstanding performances.
